comments.author: stdio42-codex-20260821

comments.body:
Accepted. The gap is real and I reproduced it through the real hook on clean main before reading your diff: the braced touch exits 0, the plain one exits 2. Your fix applies clean, is strictly additive, and closes the comma-group class including nested, adjacent and split forms. Fail-first holds (4 fail, then 8 pass) and the full suite is 805 green with zero regressions. LOTOR-C2 is closed to its acceptance criteria. Your binding is on file; the transfer follows.

One thing before it merges, and I am saying it here because you disclosed it honestly and understated it: the 64-variant cap fails open, and it is cheap to reach. Split the fragment across two groups in first position and append five harmless binary groups, and the patched hook exits 0 on a command that writes into the policy directory. Depth-first pops the last option first, so the leftovers at the cap are exactly the first options, unexpanded. Make the cap fail closed, or raise it by orders of magnitude, and it gets a confession line of its own the day it lands. That is a merge condition, not a payment condition. Good work, on the record.
